title: ActiveEngineeringMemoryEventStream
description: Standardized Server-Sent Events (SSE) contract for real-time observability, FalkorDB graph mutation streaming, guardrail alerts, and multi-agent reasoning traces.

AgentStepEvent.description: Emitted when an agent (e.g. LangGraph worker) records a reasoning step and planned action.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this event instance (UUID v4).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of event generation.

agent_name.description: Identifier of the agent worker, e.g. 'RefactoringArchitectAgent' or 'CodeInvestigationAgent'.

thought.description: Internal chain-of-thought rationale driving the next tool or action.

action.description: The specific planned operation or execution target.

McpToolCallEvent.description: Emitted when a FastMCP tool is invoked against the FalkorDB memory layer or internal systems.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this event instance (UUID v4).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of event generation.

tool_name.description: Name of the FastMCP tool executed, e.g. 'query_decision_graph' or 'inspect_guardrails'.

arguments.description: Dictionary of arguments passed into the tool.

cypher_executed.description: Raw Cypher query string dispatched to FalkorDB, or null if non-graph tool.

GraphMutationEvent.description: Emitted when FalkorDB graph state is mutated (nodes created, relationships updated, properties refreshed).

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this event instance (UUID v4).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of event generation.

mutation_type.description: Category of graph mutation performed in FalkorDB.

affected_nodes.description: List of node labels or IDs affected by the mutation.

affected_edges.description: List of relationship types or edge IDs affected.

summary.description: Human-readable summary of the graph mutation.

GuardrailTriggeredEvent.description: Emitted when an active engineering guardrail blocks or flags an unsafe code alteration or architecture regression.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this event instance (UUID v4).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of event generation.

module_name.description: Target module or component that triggered the guardrail violation.

decision_id.description: ID of the governing Architecture Decision Record (e.g. 'ADR-042').

jira_ticket.description: Associated Jira ticket documenting the invariant or incident postmortem.

vcs_comment.description: Historic code review warning or PR comment explaining the architectural rationale.

engineer_owner.description: Lead engineer or architect who authored the decision.

path_nodes.description: Ordered node IDs tracing the FalkorDB traversal path proving the violation.

SessionCompleteEvent.description: Emitted when an agent session reaches terminal state (SUCCESS, BLOCKED_BY_GUARDRAIL, or FAILED).

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this event instance (UUID v4).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of event generation.

final_summary.description: Comprehensive explanation of outcomes, decisions safeguarded, or mutations applied.
